name: Re:quiem [After the rain]
source:
In a world where mankind has not yet reached the moon.A mysterious rain falls on the peaceful town of "Madoromi-machi".Sayuri Hitohana struggles to find out the cause of the rain for the sake of the precious people caught in it... This is one of the possible stories before Sayuri goes the true route.Recommended for those who like adolescence, unrequited love, romance, and science fiction (a bit mysterious).

[Translated From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8009]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
在人类尚未到达月球的世界里，一场神秘的雨降临在宁静的小镇“圆美町”。一花小百合为了被困在雨中的珍贵的人们，努力找出下雨的原因……这是小百合走上正路之前可能发生的故事之一。推荐给那些喜欢青春期、单相思、浪漫和科幻小说（有点神秘）的人。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8009]NovelGame[/url]]
